mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) can potentiate amlodipine's vasodilatory effects and increase hypotension risk; additionally, MAOIs may interact with amlodipine's sympathomimetic metabolites or concurrent sympathomimetic use, risking hypertensive crisis.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely if combination is necessary; ensure no concurrent sympathomimetics; consider alternative antihypertensive if feasible; educate patient on dietary tyramine restriction.
